India International Centre, New Delhi, is a premier cultural and intellectual hub that brings together thought leaders, artists, scholars, and diplomats from around the world. The IIC is widely regarded as a serene space where people meet to initiate the exchange of new ideas and knowledge in the spirit of international cooperation.
